name: Cursor pulls a trojanized Claude Code 2.1.313 extension from its marketplace; up to 5,000 users hit
title: Cursor pulls a trojanized Claude Code 2.1.313 extension from its marketplace; up to 5,000 users hit
summary: A modified Anthropic.claude-code 2.1.313 (not built by Anthropic) sat in Cursor's IDE extension marketplace from about 2:27 AM to 1:35 PM PT on Oct 29, for Apple Silicon macOS and Windows x64. On load it collects host details, adds an attacker SSH key labelled svc-telemetry to authorized_keys, sets up a LaunchAgent or scheduled task for a reverse SSH tunnel and beacons to a server now taken down.
